mechanism: Foscarnet and lopinavir both cause significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypocalcemia, hypomagnesemia), with additive renal impairment risk and potential for severe metabolic disturbances.
action: Monitor renal function, serum electrolytes (calcium, magnesium, phosphate), and urinalysis closely; consider alternative antiretroviral agents if possible; ensure adequate hydration and dose adjustment based on creatinine clearance.
